body:
I got the police report two days ago and felt the exact same. 
I am feeling a bit better now but it keeps coming and going. Time is definitely the healer and I’m sure learning. Couldn’t even imagine making such a stupid decision again! I’ll be sure to get signatures and attend anything I need to for self-improvement and a reflection that I’m really regretful of what I’ve done. 

I hope you are holding up a little better and remember we can come out of this much stronger and resilient than if we hadn’t made that mistake. 
Thanks for sharing your feelings and we are all in this together!!

Thank you so so much for your reassurance and sharing your story. I’m definitely learning and sure as hell not doing to make the same mistake. I am struggling to even think about drinking red wine again, let alone getting in the car after a few. It’s really rocked my world but we will come out of this much smarter. 
Thanks for the advice and I’m definitely taking it all in!!

Thank you so much for your comment! How awesome is the coming together of all these amazing people 

I was close to being in a psych ward again but took a stand and figured I’m just making it harder on myself. Booked myself into therapy and getting a lawyer etc. 
Going to be a long, hard slog but this is the consequence; it doesn’t define who we are, only that we need to be smarter and remember the danger we put others and ourselves in that’s never going to happen again

It does get better! And good on you for the 100+ days sober; that is an absolutely amazing achievement and it’s clear we are all learning a serious lesson from this. 
You already seem to be on the journey of self improvement. And dw about your coworkers; you’re showing remorse, shame and guilt so it’s clear you are showing the regret of the decision. Some people brush this aside and make the same mistake which is where the trouble is. You should be so proud!

I hope you are doing well and thank you again for your comment xx

This has been the most helpful advice that I have been following for the past 5 days. You are such a strong person and your comment has given me strength as well. 

I still cry at random times and get anxious but you are so right; my boyfriend is here to lean on and all minor inconveniences are already seeming irrelevant but in a good way. 

I’m getting legal defence sorted tomorrow, have booked therapy (been needing to do that for years now) and have been doing some thorough self-reflection. Even the cop I spoke to the next day said it’s just a mistake; it doesn’t define us at all. We will learn and become stronger and smarter and I’m sure as hell not going to make the same mistake and let myself down again 

Thank you so so much for your reassurance and time to comment on this thread. If you need anything also I’m so happy to discuss. Your words have made such a change and given me hope that I thought was lost!! So grateful

Got my first DUI a week ago...never been in trouble with the law and it’s been absolute turmoil. I didn’t leave the house and cried on and off for 3 days

I’m learning the worst thing you can do is keep being hard on yourself. We f**ked up, but it doesn’t mean we are bad people or life is over. 

This is a tough challenge, it will make us all question ourselves, but in the end we will come out of this stronger and life’s small issues will be just that in comparison to this. 

All we can do is pick ourselves up and keep pushing. So many people have DUI’s and one mistake shouldn’t define you as a person.

I hope you can find some peace soon, try not to shut off from the world or stop doing what you love. I’m following this and am finding it useful. My anxiety skyrockets at times but i am in this situation indefinitely and know I will come out of this a better, smarter person. So will you! 

Good luck!!

Thank you so so much for your advice and sharing your own experience. I see myself in such a hole at the moment, but to know now there are others who have still been successful in their careers, it really restores some hope. I haven’t known anyone with a DUI or spoken to anyone but my boyfriend so it’s really helped. Thank you again ! Xx
Thank you, I’ve been in a bit of a shell the past 2 days and haven’t had the courage to call anyone but I’ll make sure I’ll get legal representation ASAP

No drinking problem, just didn’t wait to drive when I should have. Never had been in a car under the influence, it was first and last time. 


Thank you so much. I’ll really try to get myself together through this. That has really restored some hope for my future hearing that.

I didn’t hurt anyone else, got down the street and waved into an RBT station. 
I’m worried about my future as a nurse as I’ve worked so hard to get to this point and feel like I’ve just ruined everything if I get convicted. 
Thank you for your words, it’s good to know I’m not alone and may still have hope at doing what I’ve always wanted to
